_doc: Player-facing sentence for each win_condition metric; the value is formatted as a percentage into the %s. A mod adds a label, or patches one with override or remove, under the same name in its own data/ui/win_condition_labels.json.

literacy_elite.text: the lettered and propertied class's literacy reaches %s

epidemic_relief.text: the measures you have built have cut %s of what epidemics and famine would otherwise take
